# Audit My Business — MehyarSoft LLC

> The automated $330 business audit sold at https://mehyar.us/audit/ — an AI audit of a small business's public website and optional CEO walkthrough video, delivered as a professional visual report by email.

## What this page sells

- Audit My Business: $330 one-time, paid by card through Stripe checkout. Our AI audits the public site (and the buyer's optional walkthrough video, transcribed and assessed), then writes a visual report: an overall score, money leaks ranked by dollar impact, flaws, prioritized fixes, and an AI opportunity map. Delivered by email within 3–5 business days with a permanent link.
- This is the automated audit. It is NOT the founder-led $330 tech audit (a human review of a website, booking path, and follow-up, invoiced by email, delivered about 3 business days after an intake call): https://mehyar.us/micro-offer

## The ladder on this page

- Free scan: $0 — scores the public site and names the top money leaks. No card.
- Full Report: $5 one-time — the complete written breakdown of the free scan: every leak found, priced and ranked.
- Audit My Business: $330 one-time — the deep audit described above.

## The $5 credit

- A buyer who purchased the $5 Full Report and checks out for Audit My Business with the same email gets the $5 credited: $330 − $5 = $325 due at checkout. The credited amount shows on the checkout page before payment.
